claim_ceiling: Formal schedule catalogue only; not a remote injector or physical execution result.

linearization_contract.reservation: atomic durable create-if-absent of (idempotency_key,payload_digest,attempt_identity) before any non-idempotent effect call
linearization_contract.same_payload: return existing reserved/applied/unknown state without a second effect
linearization_contract.changed_payload: return PayloadConflict without a second reservation
linearization_contract.post_effect_crash: preserve Unknown until owner/independent evidence resolves; never replay the same key

scenarios.description: Two coordinators concurrently submit the same key and same payload.
scenarios.expected: one reservation grant; second caller observes in-progress or prior result

scenarios.description: Two coordinators concurrently submit the same key with different payload digests.
scenarios.expected: one reservation grant; losing payload receives PayloadConflict

scenarios.description: Both coordinators read empty before either creates the reservation.
scenarios.expected: owner compare-and-set rechecks emptiness at the linearization point

scenarios.description: Owner crashes after durable reservation and before invoking the effect.
scenarios.expected: reservation remains; recovery must not allocate a second owner

scenarios.description: Effect may have occurred but outcome was not durably recorded.
Owner process restarts without its previous durable key/payload history.
scenarios.expected: Unknown/hold; absence of history is not proof of no effect

scenarios.description: Both callers attempt execution after a non-atomic reservation race.
scenarios.expected: at most one physical effect per key
